semantic_findings: Fingerprints only choose candidate buckets; all identity fields, actual features and exactrun.source_text still decide hits. Lookup borrows metadata; returned clonedArc survives request or cache eviction.

Canonical features/language are debug-only lookup preconditions. Session canonicalizes first; batch owns canonical requests. Ready and current-font-generation checks live at session/pool callers, not in insert_ready.

Direction alias only admits no-separator text and cachedAuto/Mixed to requestedLTR/RTL when run direction matches and every other identity matches. Production checks8separators; fixedfixture samples7and omitsU+2028.

Limits accept0; insertion/update precedes strict-over-limit trimming and can immediately evict the inserted slot while returnedArc remains valid. contains_exact neither aliases direction nor touches/query-counts.

begin_frame replaces per-frame operations and preservesentries/LRU. clear removes allindexes/bothbuckets/positions while accumulatingclear/evicted and preserving other framehistory. Frame label comes from caller.

Updating a slot keeps its stablekey, changesrun/entryestimate, then touches/trims. Eviction synchronizesindex and both auxiliary memberships; swap_remove repairs movedslot position under existing internal invariants.

Collision_miss requires a metadata-matching exactbucket candidate with differenttext and finalmiss. Candidate counts are existingentries actually inspected; own-key bytes measure copiedpayload lengths.
Per-entry saturated capacity/length/header/index-reserve estimates feed report and trimming; neither physical-memory upper bound nor cross-entry shared-owner unique allocation proof.
